name: publicWeb_confirmKennelRequest
description: Second half of the hashruns.org/add-kennel form (E12.F1.S8): the requester types back the six-digit code emailed to them and the EXT.OfficeForms_KennelImport request moves from awaiting email (0) to new (1) — only then does it enter the portal's review queue. The spam wall: five wrong codes mark the request spam (4) and clear the code; a code is good for 48 hours (SubmittedOn), after which re-sending the form issues a new one on the same row. Confirming an already new / approved request (status 1 or 2) succeeds again with alreadyConfirmed = 1. The row is read WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) inside the transaction. On a first confirmation the API emails the reviewers listed in rowset 2 and strips that rowset. No SP-level auth: reachable only through PublicWebAdminApi behind HC_INTERNAL_SECRET.

parameters.name: requestId
parameters.description: EXT.OfficeForms_KennelImport.KennelImportId from the form's first step. Default NULL → 1730.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: The six-digit code; spaces are removed and the value trimmed before comparison. Default NULL → 1732 (counts as a wrong attempt).

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: Always first: { success, errorCode, errorType } — lower-case, as publicWeb_createMember, so the shim passes a refusal through for the page to show. Success has errorCode = 0 and errorType = 0, not NULL.

columns.name: success
columns.description: 1 confirmed (or already was); 0 refused or failed.

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: 0 on success; 1730 not confirmable (no such request, not awaiting email, or no code), 1731 expired (> 48 h), 1732 wrong code, 1739 unhandled.

rowsets.name: ErrorDetail (on failure)

columns.name: errorId
columns.description: 1739: the HC.ErrorLog row id. 1730-1732: a fresh NEWID() with NO HC.ErrorLog row behind it.

rowsets.description: On failure. errorTitle 'Code not accepted' (1730-1732) or 'Something went wrong' (1739). errorUserMessage is the text shown on the form; after the fifth wrong code it says to fill the form in again. No debugMessage column.

columns.name: alreadyConfirmed
columns.description: 1 when the request was already status 1 or 2 (nothing changed); 0 on this confirmation.

rowsets.name: Reviewers (first confirmation only)
rowsets.description: First confirmation only (alreadyConfirmed = 0): HC.Hasher.Email of every live HC.PlatformAdmin with CanEditKennel = 1 and a non-empty address, UNION 'harriercentral@gmail.com'. The API sends the 'kennel request waiting' notice and removes this rowset from the reply.

sideEffects: UPDATE EXT.OfficeForms_KennelImport on a wrong code (1732): ConfirmAttempts + 1; at the fifth, RequestStatus = 4 (spam), ConfirmCode = NULL, ReviewNote 'Marked as spam: five wrong confirmation codes'.
UPDATE EXT.OfficeForms_KennelImport on success: RequestStatus = 1, ConfirmedAt, ConfirmCode = NULL, updatedAt.
INSERT HC.ErrorLog in the CATCH (1739); the transaction is rolled back first.
API (PublicWebAdminApi): 'kennel request waiting' email to the rowset 2 reviewers on a first confirmation.

codeSmells.issue: Refusal errorId has no ErrorLog row
codeSmells.detail: Lines 92-94 return errorId = NEWID() for 1730-1732 without inserting HC.ErrorLog, so the id the page could show matches nothing server-side. Wrong codes are expected traffic, so not logging them is defensible — but then errorId should be NULL rather than a dangling id.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
